name: @bohr/deploy-action
description: GitHub Action that deploys a bohr.io Cloud managed project.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --main-fields=module,main --banner:js="import { createRequire as __bohrCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __bohrCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --legal-comments=none --metafile=dist/meta.json --outfile=dist/index.js && node scripts/licenses.mjs dist/meta.json
